decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Eldrazi creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck aims to utilize powerful Eldrazi creatures like Reality Smasher and Sire of Seven Deaths to quickly close out games. It also incorporates mana acceleration through cards like Eldrazi Temple, Ancient Tomb, and Grim Monolith to cast its threats ahead of schedule. The inclusion of cards like Wasteland and Wastescape Battlemage helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base, further enhancing the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Murktide Regent, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, Archon of Cruelty, and others. The deck utilizes a combination of discard spells like Thoughtseize, counter magic like Force of Will, and card draw/filtering spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to set up the graveyard and protect the combo. With a mix of powerful threats and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond effectively.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize the Mystic Forge card in combination with various key artifacts and support cards to create a powerful and consistent combo. By assembling the right pieces such as Glaring Fleshraker, Karn, the Great Creator, and Planar Nexus, this deck aims to generate significant value and potentially win the game in a single turn. With the ability to manipulate artifacts and generate mana efficiently, this combo-heavy archetype is designed to overwhelm opponents with its synergistic interactions and explosive plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly bin a powerful creature like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier with cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bring them back onto the battlefield to gain a huge advantage. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo, as well as card draw and counterspells to maintain consistency and protect the combo. The deck aims to win the game quickly by reanimating powerful threats while controlling the opponent's board state.

This Bant Control deck focuses on disruption and removal to control the game while also utilizing powerful card advantage engines like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck is able to protect itself with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, while also having access to board wipes like Supreme Verdict. The deck also has a variety of utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and grind them out in a long game.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. It also features disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its threats and counter opponent's key plays. The deck includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes cards like Scalding Tarn and Volcanic Island. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced tempo strategy while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of the deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counter spells and removal, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures and tempo plays. The deck aims to control the board by utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize to interact with the opponent's cards effectively. It also includes efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Brazen Borrower to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck features a mix of disruption, aggression, and tempo to keep the opponent on their toes and force them to react to your plays.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the game. The deck aims to use its graveyard as a resource for powerful threats, combining reanimation spells with powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the game and protect the combo. The deck utilizes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty to quickly close out games, while also having access to counterspells like Force of Will and Brazen Borrower for additional protection. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures or combo pieces and then bringing them back into play using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The main win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty or Murktide Regent while also having access to utility creatures like Brazen Borrower. The deck aims to win the game through explosive graveyard interaction and efficient card advantage.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays that utilize powerful dragons and artifacts. By using mana acceleration cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly deploy threats such as Magus of the Moon and Pyrogoyf to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon further disrupt the opponent's strategies, while cards like The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional firepower. Overall, this deck aims to lock down the opponent and close out the game quickly with powerful creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and then bringing them back onto the battlefield using spells like Shallow Grave, Animate Dead, and Reanimate. This allows for explosive plays and the ability to quickly overwhelm opponents with big threats. The deck includes cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize to set up the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of cards like Unmask and Cabal Therapy also helps to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's hands.

This control deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan while staying ahead in card advantage. It also utilizes enchantments like Back to Basics and Dress Down to slow down the opponent's mana production and disrupt any key creature abilities. The deck aims to control the game tempo with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, while using Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thundertrap Trainer to generate card advantage and pull ahead in the late game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and lock the opponent out of certain strategies. The deck also makes use of cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Hullbreacher to further stifle the opponent's resources. The goal is to maintain control of the game until you can establish a strong board presence and close out the game in your favor.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck runs several disruption and protection spells like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Pithing Needle to prevent opponents from interfering with the combo. Crop Rotation and Sylvan Scrying help tutor for the necessary pieces, while cards like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Lotus Petal provide mana acceleration. Other cards like Collective Brutality and Boseiju, Who Endures offer additional versatility and protection to the deck. The goal is to win through a powerful combo finish.

The main concept of this deck is to use the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library quickly, winning the game on the spot. This is supported by cards like Goblin Welder, Goblin Engineer, and Urza's Saga to tutor for pieces of the combo while disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to assemble the combo as fast as possible, using mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal, and protect it with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Pyroblast.
